data.titulo: Hais kom ntawm Ijipteem kaj dim
data.contenido:
Mi pariat chauh Tuilet an dam khawchhuak a, mahse a hunah chuan sang tam tak tling khawpin an pung a. Tichuan, Tuilet hnu kum 352-ah Abrahama a piang a. Fapa Isaka pein Pathianin Abrahama hnena a thutiam a hlenzia kan hria. Tin Isaka fapate pahnihah Pathianin Jakoba a thlang a.

Jakoba chuan fapa 12 leh fanu thenkhat nen chhung ruai pui mai a nei a. Jakoba fapa 10-te chuan an nau Josefa chu an hua a, Aigupta-a bawih-nihnaah an hralh a. A hnuah Josefa chu Aigupta-a roreltu pawimawh a lo ni a. Tam tha lo a tlak laiin Josefa chuan a unauten an thinlung an thlak leh thlak loh a chhin a. A tawpah, Jakoba chhungkaw pum pui, Israel-mite chu Aigupta-ah an pem a. Chu chu Abrahama pian hnu kum 290-ah a thleng a ni.

A hnu kum 215 chhung zawng Israel-mite chu Aigupta-ah chuan an cheng a. Josefa thih hnuah chuan, chutah chuan bawih an lo ni ta a. A hunah, Mosia a lo piang a, Aigupta atangin Israel-mite chhan chhuak turin Pathianin a hmang a. A vaiin kum 857 chhung thawnthu Bung HNIH hian a huap a ni.

LAWNG atanga amah leh a chhungte an chhuahn laia Nova thiltih hmasak ber i hria em? Pathian hnenah thil hlan emaw thilpek emaw a siam a ni. A hnuaia milemah hian chumi a ti lai mek chu i hmu thei. Tuilet ropui atanga a chhungte a chhandam avangin Nova chuan he ran thilpek hi Pathian hnenah a hlan a ni.

Jehovan thilpek chu a lawm i ring em? Aw, lawm e. Chuvangin tuiletin khawvel a tiboral leh tawh ngai lovang tih a tiam a ni.



Ram chu a hui thuai a, Nova leh a chhungte chuan lawng pawnah nun thar an tan ta a. Pathianin mal a sawm a an hnenah: ‘Fate tam tak in nei tur a ni. Lei chung zawng zawnga mite an awm vek thlengin in pung tur a ni,’ tiin a hrilh a.

Mahse a hnuah, miten tuilet ropui chanchin an hriat hunah, chutiang tuilet chu a thleng leh ang tih an hlau thei ang a. Chuvangin Pathianin lei pum puiah tui a tilet ngai tawh lovang tih a tiam chu mite hriat nawntirna turin engemaw a pe a. Anmahni hriat nawntir nan chuan enge a pek i hria em? Chhimbal a ni.

Ruah sur hnua ni a satin vanah chhimbal hmuh a ni fo. Chhimbal chuan rawng mawi tam tak a nei thei. Pakhat tal i hmu ngai em? Milema pakhat hi i hmu em?

‘Mipui leh ramsate zawng zawng hi tuileta tihboral an ni leh ngai lovang tih ka tiam e. Chhumahte ka chhimbal ka dah dawn a. Tin chhimbal chu a Jan hunah, ka en ang a, he ka thutiam hi ka hrereng ang,’ tih hi Pathian sawi chu a ni.

Chuvangin chhimbal i hmuh hunah enge a hriat nawntir ang che? Tuilet ropuiin khawvel a tiboral leh ngai lovang tih Pathian thutiam hi a ni.Genesis 8:18-22; 9:9-17. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

data.titulo: Miten Insang Lian Pui An Sa
data.contenido:
KUM tam tak a rai a. Nova fapate chuan fate tam tak an nei a. Tin an fate chu an lo puitling a, fate tam lehzual an nei a. Leilungah mi tam tak an awm thuai a.

Chung mite zinga pakhat chu Nova tuchhuan Nimroda an tih chu a ni. Mite leh ramsate pel a tihlum thintu mi tha lo a ni. Mi dangte awp turin Nimroda chuan lelberah a insiam bawk a. Pathianin Nimroda chu a duh lo. Chutih lai chuan mi zawng zawngin tawng pakhat an hmang a. Anmahni a awp theih nan Nimroda chuan awm khawmtir vek a duh a. Enge a tih i hria em? Khawpui leh a chhunga insang lian pui sa turin mipui chu a hrilh a. Milemah hian leirawhchan an siam lai en teh.

Pathian Jehovan chu insak chu a lawm lo. Pathian chuan mite chu pem chhuaka leilung zawng zawnga cheng turin a duh a. Mahse mite chuan: ‘Hawh u! khawpui leh insang, a chhip van tawng khawpa sang i sa ang u. Tichuan kan hming a thang ang!’ an ti a. Mite chuan chawimawina chu anmahni tan an duh a ni, Pathian tan ni lovin.

Chuvangin Pathianin mipui insang sak chu a tawptir a. A tihdan i hria em? Mite chu tawng pakhat aia tama thawk leh khata tawng hranga tawngtirin. Insatute chu an inhrethiam tawh lo va. Hei hi an khawpui Babel emaw Babulon emaw, a awmzia “Buaina“ tia vuah a nihna chhan chu a ni.

Babel atangin mite chu an pem tan ta a. Tawng thuhmun hmang hote chu hmun danga cheng za turin an kal tan ta a.Genesis 10:1, 8-10; 11:1-9. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

TUILET hnua cheng tura mite kalna hmun pakhat chu Ur vuah a ni. A chhunga in thenkhat tha takte nen khawpui pawimawh a lo ni a. Mahse chuta mite chuan pathian dik lote an bia a. Chu chu Babela an tih thin dan chu a ni. Ur leh Babel-a mite chu Jehova rawng bawl zeltu Nova leh a fapa Sema ang an ni lo.

A tawp, tuilet hnu kum 350-ah, mi rinawm Nova a thi a. He milema i hmuh mipa hi chumi hnu kum hnih chiahah chuan a piang a. Pathian lakah mi danglam bik deuh a ni. A hming chu Abrahama a ni. Chu Ur khawpuiah chuan a chhungte nen an cheng a.

Nikhat chu Jehovan Abrahama hnenah: ‘Ur leh i laichinte kalsan la, ka hmuhtir tur che ramah kal rawh,’ a ti a. Abrahama chuan Pathian thu a awihin Ur nawmna zawng zawng a kalsan em? Aw, a kalsan. Abrahama chuan Pathian thu a awih fo vangin a ni Pathian thian vuah a nih ni.

Ur a kalsan lai chuan Abrahama chhungte thenkhat a hnenah an kal ve a. A pa Tera a kal a. A unaupa fapa Lota pawh. Tin Abrahama nupui Sari a kal bawk a. A hunah an vaiin Tera thihna hmun Haran chu an thleng a. Ur atanga hla takah an awm ta a.

Rei lote hnuah Abrahama leh a chhungte chuan Haran an kalsan a, Kanaan an tih ram chu an thleng ta a. Chutah chuan Jehovan: ‘I fate hnena ka pek tur ram chu hei hi a ni,’ a ti a. Abrahama chu Kanaan-ah a awm a, puan inahte a cheng a.

Pathianin Abrahama chu a tanpui tan ta a, tichuan beram malte leh ran dangte leh chhiahhlawh za tam tam tak a nei a. Mahse amah leh Sari chuan anmahni fapa pakhat mah an nei lo.

Abrahama chu kum 99 a nihin Jehovan: ‘Hnam tam taka mite pa i ni ang tih ka tiam e,’ a ti a. Tunah Abrahama leh Sari chu fa nei turin an upa lutuk tawh si a, chu chu engtinnge a lo nih theih ang?Genesis 11:27-32; 12:1-7; 17:1-8, 15-17; 18:9-19. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

ABRAHAMAN hetah hian enge a tih i hmu thei em? Chemte a keng a, a fapa a tihlum dawn niin a lang. Engvanginnge chu chu a tih? A hmasain Abrahama leh Sarin fapa an neih dan i en phawt ang u.

Fapa an nei ang tih Pathianin a tiam kha hrereng la. Mahse Abrahama leh Sari an upat tawh em avangin chu chu theihin a lang lo. Amaherawchu, theih lohva lang pawh Pathianin a ti thei tih Abrahama chuan a ring a. Tichuan enge lo thleng ta?

Pathianin thu a tiam hnuah kum khat pumhlum a ral a. Tin Abrahama chu kum 100-a upa leh Sari chu kum 90-a upa a nihin fapa an nei a, a hmingah lsaka an sa a. Pathian chuan a thutiam a hlen ngei mai.

Mahse Isaka a lo upat deuhvin, Jehovan Abrahama rinna a enchhina. ‘Abraham,’ a ti a. Abrahama chuan: ‘Heta hi ka awm,’ tiin a chhang a. Tichuan Pathianin: ‘I fapa, i fapa neihchhun Isaka hruai la, ka hmuhtir tur che tlang chhipah kal rawh. Chutah chuan i fapa tihlum la, inthawina angin hlan rawh,’ a ti a.

Abrahama chuan a fapa a hmangaih em em vangin chung thute chuan Abrahama chu a va tilungngai em! Abrahama fate chu Kanaan ramah an cheng ang tih Pathianin a tiam kha hrereng la. Mahse Isaka a thih chuan chu chu engtinnge a nih theih ang? Abrahama chuan a hre thiam lo va, mahse Pathian thu a la awih tho va.

Tlang a thlen chuan Abrahaman lsaka a phuar a, a maicham siamah chuan a dah a. Tin a fapa tihlum turin chemte a phawrh a. Mahse chutih lai tak chuan Pathian vantirhkohvin a ko va: ‘Abraham, Abraham,’ tiin. Tin Abrahama chuan: ‘Heta hi ka awm,’ a ti a.

Naupang chu tina suh la, a chungah engmah ti suh. Tunah chuan i fapa i neihchhun pawh ka tan i ui loh vangin, keimahah rinna i nei tih ka hria,’ Pathianin a ti ta a.

Abrahaman Pathian rinna a va nei nasa em! Jehova tan engmah theih loh a awm lo va, Jehova chuan thihna atangin Isaka a kaitho thei tih a ring a. Mahse Abrahaman lsaka a tihhlum chu Pathian duhzawng a ni tak tak lo. Chuvangin a kiang thingbukah Pathianin beram a tantir a, a fapa aia inthawi nana hmang turin Abrahama a hrilh ta a.Genesis 21:1-7; 22:1-18. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

data.titulo: Lota Nupuiin Hnung Lam A Hawi
data.contenido:
KANAAN ramah chuan Abrahama hnenah Lota leh a chhungte an cheng ve a. Ni khat chu Abrahaman Lota hnenah: ‘Hetah hian kan ran zawng kham khawp ram a awm lo va. Khawngaitakin i awm hrang ang. Kawng khata i kal leh a dangah ka kal ang e,’ a ti a.

Lotan ram chu a thlir a. A rante tana hnim tha tam tak leh tui awmna ram hmun tha tak a hmu a. Chu chu Jordan phaizawl a ni. Tichuan chutah chuan Lotan a chhungte leh a rante a pem luhpui a. A tawpah Sodom khawpuiah chuan awmhmun a khuar ta a.

Sodom mite chu an tha lo em em a. Lota chu mi tha a nih vangin chu chuan a timangang a. Pathian pawh a mangang ve bawk a. A tawpah an that lohna vangin Sodom leh a kianga khawpui Gomorra chu a tiboral dawn tih Lota vaukhan turin Pathianin vantirhkoh pahnih a tira.

Vantirhkohte chuan Lota chu an hrilh a: ‘Hmnanhmawh rawh! I nupui leh i fanu pahnihte hi hruai la, hetata hi chhuak rawh!’ tiin. Lota leh a chhungte chu tlemin an kal muang deuh va, chuvangin vantirhkohte chuan an kutah an chelh a, khawpui ata an hruai chhuak a. Tin vantirhkoh zinga pakhat chuan: ‘ln nun nan tlan rawh u! Hnung lam hawi suh u. Tlangahte tlan rawh u, tichuan tihhlum in ni lo vang,’ a ti a. Lota leh a fanute chuan thu an awih a, Sodom ata an tlan chhuak a, chawlh pawh an chawl lo va, hnung lam pawh an hawi lo. Mahse Lota nupui chuan thu a awih lo va. Sodom atanga tlem an kal hnuah a ding a, hnung lam a hawi a. Tichuan Lota nupui chu chi khawn dingah a chang ta a. Milemah amah in hmu thei em?

Hemi atang hian zirtur kan hre thei. Pathianin a thu awihtute chu a chhandam a, mahse a thu awi lotute chuan an nun an hloh ang tih a tilang.Genesis 13:5-13; 18:20-33; 19:1-29; Luka 17:28-32; 2 Petera 2:6-8. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

HE MILEMA hmeichhia hi tunge ni i hria em? A hming chu Rebeki a ni. A tawh dawn mek mipa hi Isaka a ni. A nupui a ni dawn. Engtinnge chu chu a lo nib?

E, Isaka pa Abrahama chuan a fapa tan nupui tha a duh a. Kanaan-a hmeichheho chuan pathian dik lote an biak avangin Isakan an zinga mi a neih chu a duh lo. Chuvangin Abrahama chuan a chhiahhlawh a ko va: ‘Ka laichinte chenna Harana kir a ka fapa lsaka tan nupui hmu turin ka duh che,’ a ti a.

Abrahama chhiahhlawh chuan sanghawngsei sawm a la a, khual hla tak chu a zin nghal a. Abrahama laichinte chenna hmun hnaih a thlenin tuichhunchhuahah a chawl a. Tuichhunchhuaha tui chawi tura khawpuia hmeichhiate lokal hun, chawhnu tlailam a ni. Tichuan Abrahama chhiahhlawh chu Jehova hnenah a tawngtai a: ‘Kei leh sanghawngseite tana tui chawitu hmeichhia chu Isaka nupui tura i thlan chu ni rawh se,’ tiin.

Tui chawi turin Rebeki a lo kal thuai a. Chhiahhlawhin tui a dilin a pe a. Tin a kal a, sanghawngsei tuihal zawng zawng kham khawp tui a chawi a. Sanghawngseite chuan tui tam deuh deuh an in vangin chu chu hna hahthlak tak a ni.

Chu chu Rebekin a tih zawh veleh, Abrahama chhiahhlawh chuan a pa hming a zawt a. An ina zan a riah theih dawn leh dawn loh a zawt bawk a. Ani chuan: ‘Ka pa chu Bethuela a ni a, kan hnena i thlenna turin hmun a awm,’ a ti a. Abrahama chhiahhlawh chuan Bethuela chu Abrahama unaupa Nahora fapa a ni tih a hria a. Tichuan a thingthi a, Jehovan Abrahama laichinte hnena a hruai vangin a hnenah lawmthu a sawi a.

Chumi zan chuan Abrahama chhiahhlawh chuan a lo kal chhan chu Bethuela leh Rebeki nuta Labana a hrilh a. Rebeki chu Isaka nei tura a kalpui an remti ve ve a. Amah an han zawhin Rebekin enge a sawi? ‘Aw le,’ a ti a, kal a duh a. Tichuan chumi tuk ngei chuan sanghawngsei chungah an chuang a, Kanaan ram hla taka zin tur chuan an kal ta a.

An lo thlen chuan tlailam a ni a. Rebeki chuan phula mipa kal a hmu a. lsaka a ni a, Rebeki a hmu chu a lawm a. A hma kum thum lekah a nu Sari a thi tawh a, a la lungchhe reng a. Mahse tunah chuan Isaka chuan Rebeki chu a hmangaih ta em em a, a hlim leh ta a.Genesis 24:1-67. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

HETA mipa naupang pahnihte hi an inang lo ngawt lawm ni? An hming i hria em? Sa pel mi hi Esaua a ni a, beram veng naupang hi Jakoba a ni.

Esaua leh Jakoba chu Isaka leh Rebeki fa phir an ni. Esaua chu sa pel thiam a ni a, an chhungkaw ei turin inah ei tur a rawn hawn thin vangin a pa Isaka chuan a hmangaih em em a. Mahse Rebeki chuan Jakoba chu, a ngawichawi leh zaidam vangin a hmangaih ber a.



An pu Abrahama chu a la dam a, Jehova chanchin a sawi Jakoban a ngaihthlak duhzia kan ngaihruat thei. Phirte chu kum 15 an nihin Abrahama chu kum 175-a upain a thi a.

Esaua chu kum 40 a nihin Kanaan rama mi hmeichhe pahnih nupuiah a nei a. Chung hmeichhiate chuan Jehova an biak loh vangin, chu chuan lsaka leh Rebeki a tilungngai em em mai a.

Ni khat chu, a unaupa Jakoba chunga a thinrim em emna tur thil engemaw a lo awm a. Isakan a fapa upa zawk hnena malsawmna a pek hun a lo thleng ta. Esaua chu Jakoba aia a upat zawk vangin chu malsawmna chu Esaua chuan dawn a inring a. Mahse a hmain Esaua chuan malsawm dawn theihna chu Jakoba hnenah a hralh tawh a. Tin, naupang pahnihte chu an pian lai pawhin Pathianin Jakoban malsawmna a dawng ang a lo ti tawh bawk a. Tichuan hei hi a lo ni ta a ni. Isakan a fapa Jakoba hnenah malsawmna a pe ta.

A hnuah chu chu Esauan a hriatin Jakoba chungah a thimrim a. A thinrirn khawp a, Jakoba tihhlurn hial a duh a. Rebekin chu chu a hriatin a lungkharn em ern a. Tichuan a pasal Isaka a hrilh a: ‘Jakoban heng Kanaan hrneichhiate hi nupuia a neih ve chuan a rapthlak dawn ern mai,’ tiin.

Chu veleh Isakan a fapa Jakoba a ko va: ‘Kanaan-a mi hmeichhia nupuiah nei suh. Harana i pu Bethuela inah kal zawk la. A fapa Labana fanute zinga pakhat nupuiah nei rawh,’ tiin a hril a.

Jakoban a pa thu a ngaithla a, a laichinta awrnna Haran-ah, khual zinna hla takah a kal ta nghal a.Genesis 25:5-11, 20-34; 26:34, 35; 27:1-46; 28:1-5; Hebrai 12:16, 17. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

HENG Jakoban a biak mite hi tute nge ni i hria em? Ni tam tak a zin hnuah, Jakoban tuichhunchhuah kiangah a tawk a. An beram an veng a ni. Jakoba chuan: ‘Khawia mi nge in nih,’ tiin a zawt a.

’Haran-a mi,’ an ti a.

’Labana in hria em?’ Jakoba chuan a ti a.

’Aw.’ En teh afanu Rakili a beram rual nen a lo kal,’ tiin an chhang a. Ralkhata Rakili lo kal saw in hmu thei em? Jakoban a unau Labana beram nena Rakili lo kal a hmuhin, a kal a, beramin tui an in theih nan tuichhunchhuch ata lung a lum sawn a. Tin Jakoban Rakili a fawp a, tunge a nih a hrilh a. A lawm khawp a, a haw a, a pa Labana hrilh a.

A hnenah Jakoba a awm chu Labana a hlim em em a. Jakoban nupuia neih atan Rakili a dil chuan Labana a lawm a. Amaherawhchu, Rakili hlawh turin lova kum sarih thawk turin Jakoba a ngen a. Rakili a duh em vangin Jakoban chu chu rem a ti a. Mahse inneih hun a lo thlenin, enge lo ni ta i hria em?

Labana chuan Rakili aiah a fanu upa zawk Leaii chu Jakoba hnenah a pe a. Jakoban Labana tan kum sarih dang thawh leh rem a tih veleh, Labana pawhin Rakili chu a nupuiah a pe a. Chung lai chuan Pathianin mipate chu nupui pakhat aia tam an neih a phal a. Mahse tunah chuan, Biblein a tihlan angin, mipain nupui pakhat chauh a nei tur a ni.Genesis 29:1-30. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

HE CHHUNG ruai deuh hi en teh. Hengte hi Jakoba fapa 12-te an ni. Fanute pawh a nei. A fate hming pakhat tal i hria em? An Zinga thenkhat i hria ang u.

Leaiin Reubena, Simeona, Levia leh Juda a hring a. Rakili chuan fa a neih loh a hriatin a lungngai em em a. Chutichuan a chhiahhlawh Bilhaii chu Jakoba hnenah a pe a, Bilhaii chuan fapa pahnih Dana leh Naphtalia a nei a. Tin Leaii pawhin a chhiahhlawh nula Zilpaii chu Jakoba hnenah a pe a, Zilpaii chuan Gada leh Ashera a hring a. Leaii chuan atawpah fapa pahnih, Issakara leh Zebuluna a nei leh a.

A tawpah Rakili chuan fa a nei thei ta a. Josefa a vuah a. A hnuah Josefa chu mi pawimawh a rawn nih avangin a chanchin tam tak kan hre leh ang. Chungte chu Rakili pa Labana hnena a chen laia Jakoba laka fapa 1I piangte chu an ni.

Jakoba chuan fanute pawh a nei a, mahse Bible-in pakhat hming chauh a sawi a. A hming chu Dinaii a ni. Jakoba chuan Labana kalsana Kanaan-a haw leh a inpuahchah hun a thleng ta a. Tichuan a chhung ruai tak leh a beram ruai leh a ran ruai tam tak chu a hruai khawm a, zin kawng thui tak chu an kal tan ta a.

Kanaan-a Jakoba leh a chhungte rei vak lo an chen hnuin Rakili chuan fapa dang a hring leh a. Khual an zin laiin a hring a. Rakili chuan a vei nasa a, a tawpah a hrin laiin athi ta a. Mahse nausen mipa chu a dam a, Jakoban Benjamina a sa a.

Anmahni atanga Israel hnam pum pui a lo chhuah avangin Jakoba fapa 12-te hming hi hriat reng kan duh a. Dik takin, Israel hnam 12-te chu Jakoba fapa 10-te leh Josefa fapa pahnihte hming chawia sak an ni. Chung naupang zawng zawng pian hnu rei tak thlengin Isaaka chu a dam a. Tupa chu zozai a nei chu a hlimpui ngei ang. Mahse a tunu Dinaii chungah enge thleng i en ang u.Genesis 29:32-35; 30:1-26; 35:16-19; 37:35. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

DINAII lenna turte hi i hmu em? Kanaan rama cheng hmeichhe thenkhat a va hmu dawn a ni. A pa Jakoba chuan hei hi a lawm ang em? Chu zawhna chhan theih nan chuan Abrahama leh Isakan Kanaan hmeichhiate an ngaihdan hriat reng tum la. Abrahaman a fapa lsaka chu Kanaan-a mi nula nupuia nei turin a duh em? Aih, a duh lo. Isaka leh Rebekin an fapa Jakoba chu Kanaan nula nupuia nei turin an duh em? Aih, an duh lo. A chhan i hria em?

Chung Kanaan-ho chuan pathian dik lote an biak vangin a ni. Nupui pasala neih atana tha an ni lo va, thian kawmngeiha neihah pawh an tha lo. Chuvangin a fanuin heng Kanaan nulate a kawmngeih hi Jakoba a lawm lovang tih kan hre thei.

Tih ang ngeiin Dinaiin buaina a tawk. Milema Dinaii entu Kanaan mipa hi i hmu thei em? A hming chu Sekema a ni. Ni khat chu Dinaii a lo len laiin, Sekeman Dinaii a man a, a mutpui lui a. lnnei tawh mipa leh hmeichhia chauh mu dun tur an nih avangin chu chu a dik lo a ni. Dinaii chunga Sekema tih chu thil tha lo chuan buaina tam zawk a thlentir ta a ni.

Dinaii nutaten chu chu an hriatin, an thinur em em a. An zinga pahnih, Simeona leh Levia chu an thinrim khawp a, khandaih an la a, khawpuiah an kal a, an rin loh hlanah mipate chu an va nang a. Anni leh an unaute chuan Sekema leh mipa dang zawng zawng an that vek a. Chu thil tha lo chu a fapaten an tih avangin Jakoba chu a thinur a.

Engtinnge chung buaina zawng zawng chu a intan? Dinaiin Pathian dan awih lo mite a kawmngeih vang a ni. Chutiang thian neih chu kan duh lo vang, kan duh ang em?Genesis 34:1-31. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

TLANGVAL lungngaihzia leh beidawnzia hi en teh. Hei hi Josefa a ni. A unauten heng Aigupta-a kal mekte hnenah hian an hralh hlim a ni. Chutah chuan Josefa chu bawiha siam a ni ang. Engvanginnge a unaute chuan chu thil tha lo chu an tih? Josefa an thik vang a ni.

An pa Jakoba chuan Josefa chu a duh em em a. A tan kawrfual mawi deuh siamin a duhsakzia a tilang a. Jakoban Josefa a hmangaihzia chu a u 10-ten an hmuhin, Josefa chu thikin an haw ta a ni. An huatna chhan dang a la awm.

Josefan mumang pahnih a nei a. Josefa mumangahte chuan a hmaah a unaute an kun a. Josefan chung a mumangte chu a unaute a hrilhin, amah an huatna a nasa lehzual a.

Ni khat chu Josefa uten an pa beram an ven laiin, engtinnge an awm zel tih ena kal turin Jakoban Josefa a tir a. Josefa unauten a lo kal an hmuh chuan, an zinga thenkhat chuan: ‘I tihlum ang u,’ an ti a. Mahse a upa ber Reubena chuan: ‘Ni lo ve, chu chu ti suh u,’ a ti a. Josefa chu an man ta zawk a. Tuichhunchhuah kang tawhah an thlak a. Engtia tih tur nge tih rel turin an thu ta a. Chutih lai vel chuan Ishmael-mi thenkhat an lo kal a. Juda chuan a unaute hnenah: ‘Ishmael-mite hnenah hian i hralh ang u,’ ati a. Chutiang chuan an ti ta a. Josefa chu tangkaraw nawi 20-ah an hralh ta a.

A unaute chuan enge an pa an hrilh ang? Kel an talh a, kel thisenah chuan Josefa kawr mawi tak chu an hnim an hniam a. Tichuan kawr chu an pa Jakoba hnenah an hawpui a: ‘Hei hi kan chhar. Han en teh, Josefa kawr alo ni ang e,’ an ti a.

Jakoba chuan a ni tih a hria a. ‘Ram sakawlhin Josefa a tihlum a nih dawn hi,’ tiin a tap ta a. Chu ngei chu Josefa unauten an pain ring se an tih chu a ni. Jakoba chu a lungngai em em a. Ni tam tak a tap a. Mahse Josefa chu a thi lo. An kalpuinaah chuan enge thleng i en ang u.Genesis 37:1-35. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

data.titulo: Josefa Tân Inah Khung A Ni
data.contenido:
JOSEFA chu Aigupta-a an kalpui lai chuan kum 17 chauh a ni a. Chutah chuan mi pakhat Potiphara hnenah hralh a ni a. Potiphara chuan Pharaoa an tih, Aigupta lalber tan hna a thawk a ni.

Josefa chu a pu Potiphara tan hna a thawk nasa a. Chuvangin Josefa a upat chuan Potiphara chuan a in pum pui enkawltuah a dah a. A nih, engvanginnge Josefa chu he tan inah hian a awm? Potiphara nupui vang a ni.

Josefa chu mipa hmeltha deuh a rawn ni a, tin Potiphara nupui chuan a hnena mu turin a duh a. Chu chu a dik lo tih Josefan a hria a, a ti lo vang. Potiphara nupui chu a thinrim em em a. Tichuan a pasal lo haw chuan a hnenah dawt a sawi a: ‘He mi tha lo Josefa hian a hnenah mi mut luihtir,’ tiin. Josefa chungah a thinrim ta em em a. Tichuan tan inah a khung ta a ni.

Tan in enkawltu chuan Josefa chu mi tha a ni tih a hre thuai a. Chuvangin mi tang zawng zawng enkawltuah a dah a. A hnuah Pharaoa chu a uain petu leh chhang siamtu chungah a thinur a, tan inah a khung a. Zan khat chu mumang danglam bik an nei ve ve a, mahse an mumang awmzia chu an hre lo. A tukah chuan Josefa chuan: ‘In mumangte mi hrilh rawh u,’ a ti a. An han hrilh chuan, Pathian tanpuinain Josefa chuan an mumang awmziate chu a hrilhfiah a.

Uain petu hnenah chuan, Josefa chuan: ‘Ni thumah tan in ata chhuah i ni ang a, Pharaoa uain petu i ni leh ang,’ a ti a. Josefa chuan: ‘I chhuah hunah, ka chanchin Pharaoa hrilh la, he hmun atanga chhuak turin mi tanpui ang che,’ a tih belh a. Chhang siamtu hnenah erawh chuan, Josefa chuan: ‘Ni thum chiahah Pharaoan i lu a tan ang,’ a ti a.

Ni thumah chuan Josefa sawi ang chiah chuan athleng ta a. Pharaoa chuan chhang siamtu lu a tan a. Uain petu erawh chu tan in ata chhuah a ni a, lalber hna a thawk leh a. Mahse uain petu chuan Josefa chanchin zawng zawng a theihnghilh vek a! A chanchin chu Pharaoa a hrilh lo va, Josefa chu tan inah a awm ta zel a.Genesis 39:1-23; 40:1-23. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

KUM hnih a vei a, Josefa chu tan inah a la awm reng a. Uain petu chuan amah chu a hrereng lo. Zan khat chu Pharaoan mumang danglam bik deuh mai pahnih a nei a, an awmzia a ngaihtuah a. Sawta muhil saw i hmu em? A tukah chuan Pharaoan a mifingte a ko va, mumanga a thil hmuhte chu a hrilh a. Mahse a mumang awmziate chu an hrilh thei lo.

A tawpah uain petu chuan Josefa a hre chhuak ta a. Pharaoa hnenah: ‘Tan ina ka awm lai khan chutah chuan mumang awmziate sawi theitu a awm a sin,’ a ti a. Pharaoa chuan Josefa chu tan in ata a hruaitir ta nghal a. Pharaoa chuan Josefa chu a mumangte a hrilh a: ‘Bawngpui thau nalh tak pasarih ka hmu a. Tin bawngpui cher em em leh ruh Jang thiak mai pasarih ka hmu leh a. Tin a cherte chuan bawngpui thaute chu an ei zo ta a.

’Ka mumang pahnihnaah chuan buh kung khat atangin vui tha tak, hmin tak vui sarih ka hmu a. Tin buhvui thep deuh, ro rip riap ka hmu leh a. Tin buhvui thep deuh chuan buhvui tha pasarih chu an dawlh zo ta a,’ a ti a. Josefa chuan Pharaoa hnenah: ‘Mumang pahnihte awmzia chu thil thuhmun a ni. Bawngpui thau pasarih leh buhvui tha, hmin tak pasarih te chu kum sarih tihna an ni a, tin bawngpui cher pasarih leh buhvui thep deuh pasarih chu kum sarih dang tihna an ni. Aigupta-ah buh tam taka neih hun kum sarih a awm ang a. Tin buh tlem tea neih hun kum sarih a awm leh ang,’ a ti a.

Chutichuan Josefa chuan Pharaoa a hrilh a: ‘Mi fing thlang la, kum tha kum sarih chhunga buh lakkhawm enkawltuah dah rawh. Tichuan a hnua buh tlem te neih hun kum tha lo kum sarih chhungin mipuiin chaw an nghei dawn lo nia,’ tiin.

Pharaoa chuan tha a ti a. Buh la khawm turin leh chhek khawm turin Josefa a thlang a. Pharaoa dawttuah, Josefa chu Aigupta-a mi pawimawh ber a ni ta a.

A hnu kum riatah, tam tlak chhungin, Josefa chuan mi thenkhat lo kal a hmu a. Tute nge an nih i hria em? E, a u 10-te kha an ni. Kanaan-a an inah chaw an neih loh vangin an pa Jakoban Aigupta-ah a tir a ni. Josefa chuan a unaute a hria a, mahse anni chuan amah chu an hre lo. A chhan i hria em? Josefa chu a upa tawh a, silhfen chi danga a inchei vang a ni.

Naupang a nih laiin a hnena kun turin a unaute an lo kal mumangah a mang tih Josefa chuan a la hrereng a. Chu thu i chhiar chu i hrereng em? Chuvangin Aigupta-a amah kaltirtu chu Pathian a niin, chhan tha tak vang a nih Josefan a hre thei a. Josefan enge tia i rin? I en ang u.Genesis 41:1-57; 42:1-8; 50:20. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

JOSEFA chuan a u 10-te chu ngilnei lo leh sual an la m reng em tih hriat a duh a. Chuvangin: ‘Enthlatute in ni. Khawilaiah nge kan ram hi a chak loh tih hmuchhuak tura lo kal in ni,’ a ti a.

’Ni lo, kan ni lo. Mi tluangtlam tak tak kan ni. Unau vek kan ni a. 12 kan ni. Mahse unaupa pakhat chu a awm tawh lo va, tin a naupang ber chu kan pa hnenah inah a awm,’ an ti a.

Josefa chuan a awih lo der a. Simeona hmingpu unaupa chu tan inah a khung a. a dangte chu buh a phurh hawtir a. An hnenah: ‘In lo kir hunah, in rualin in naupang ber chu in rawn hruai tur a ni,’ tiin a hrilh a.

Kanaan-a an haw chuan unaute chuan thil lo nih dan zawng zawng chu an pa Jakoba an hrilh a. Jakoba a lungngai em em a. ‘Josefa a awm tawh lo va, tunah Simeona a awm leh tawh lo va, ka fapa naupang ber Benjamina chu in rualin ka kaltir lo vang,’ tiin a tap a. Mahse an chaw a zawh hun chuan, chaw an hmuh belh theih nan Jakoba chuan Aigupta-ah Benjamina a kaltir a ngai a ni.

Josefa chuan a unaute lo kal chu a hmu a. A nau Benjamina a hmu chu a hlim em em a. Amaherawhchu an zinga tumahin he mi pawimawh tak hi Josefa a ni tih an hre lo. Josefa chuan a unau 10-te enchhinna tur thil engemaw a ti ta a.

An ip zawng zawng chu buhin a chhiahhlawhte a thun khahtir a. Mahse anmahni hriattir lovin Benjamina ipah tangkaraw no danglam bik a dah bawk a. An kal vek hnuah, tlema hla deuh an thlen hnuah, an hnungah Josefan a chhiahhlawhte a tir a. An um phak veleh chhiahhlawhte chuan: ‘Engvanginnge kan pu tangkaraw no in ruk?’ an ti a.

Unaute chuan an vaiin: ‘A no kan ru lo. Kan zinga tu hnenah pawh no chu in hmuh chuan, chu mi chu tihhlum ni rawh se,’ an ti a.

Tichuan chhiahhlawhte chuan ip zawng zawng an zawng a, heta i hmuh ang chiah hian no chu Benjamina ipah an hmuchhuak a. Chhiahhlawhte chuan: ‘A dang chu in haw thei e, mahse Benjamina chu kan hnenah a lo kal tur a ni,’ an ti a. Unau 10-te chuan enge an tih tak ang le?

An vaiin Benjamina nen Josefa inah an kir a. Josefa chuan a unaute chu: ‘ln haw vek thei e, mahse Benjamina chu hetah hian kan bawih angin a awm tur a ni,’ tiin a hrilh a.

Juda a tawng chhuak ta a: ‘Naupang tel lova ka haw chuan, amah a hmangaih nasat em avangin ka pa a thi ang. Chuvangin khawngaihtakin hetah i bawih angin mi awmtir rawh, mahse naupang chu haw rawh se,’ a ti a.

Josefa chuan a unaute chu an inthlak tawh tih a hre thei a. Ngilnei lo leh sual an ni tawh lo. Tunah Josefan enge a tih i en ang u.Genesis 42:9-38; 43:1-34; 44:1-34. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

JOSEFA chu a insum zo ta ngang lo va. Pindan chhuahsan turin a chhiahhlawh zawng zawng a hrilh a. A unaute nen chauhva an awm veleh Josefa chu a tap ta a. A tahna chhan an hriat loh vanga a unaute hrilhai turzia kan ngaihruat thei. A tawpah chuan: ‘Josefa kha ka ni. Ka pa a la dam em?’ a ti ta a.

A unaute chu an hrilhai lutuk a, an tawng thei lo va. An hlau va. Mahse Josefa chuan: ‘Khawngaihtakin lo hnai teh u,’ a ti a. An hnaih veleh: ‘Aigupta-a in hralh, in unaupa Josefa kha ka ni,’ a ti ta a.

Josefa chuan ngilnei takin a sawi zel a: ‘Heta mi hralh vang hian inthiam lo suh u. Mite nunna chhandam tura Aigupta-a mi kaltirtu chu Pathian a ni tak zet si a. Pharaoa chuan ram pum pui awptuah mi siam tawh a. Chuvangin ka pa hnenah haw thuai ula, hei hi hrilh rawh u. Tin heta lo kala cheng turin hrilh rawh u,’ a ti a.

Tin Josefa chuan a unaute chu a kuah a, a pawm a, an vaiin a fawp a. Josefa unaute an lo kal tih Pharaoan a hriatin Josefa hnenah: ‘Tawlailirte kentir la, an pa leh an chhungte va hruai sela hetah lo kir rawh se. Aigupta zawng zawnga ram tha ber an hnenah ka pe ang e,’ tiin a hrilh a.

Chutiang chuan an ti ta a. Hetah hian a chhungkaw pum puia Aigupta-a an lo kal lai a Josefan a pa a hmuak lai i hmu thei. Jakoba chhungkua chu an tam ta em em a. Aigupta a an pem lai chuan Jakoba leh a fate leh a tute chhiarin 70 an ni a. Mahse an nupuite pawh an awm a, chhiahhlawh pawh tam tak an awm mai thei. Chung zawng zawng chu Aigupta-ah an cheng ta a. Jakoba hming chu Pathianin Israela tia a thlak tawh vangin Israel-mite vuah an ni. A hnua kan la hriat tur angin, Israel-mite chu Pathian tana mi hran bik deuh an lo ni a.Genesis 45:1-28; 46:1-27. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

HE MI dam lo tan hian pawi i ti em? A hming chu Joba a ni a, hmeichhia hi a nupui a ni. Joba hnenah enge a sawi i hria em? ‘Pathian anchhia lawh la thi rawh,’ a ti a ni. Chutiang thu a sawina chhan leh Johan chuti khawpa na a tuarna chhan i en ang u.

Joba chu Jehova thu awih mi rinawm a ni a. Kanaan atanga hla lo, Uz ramah a cheng a. Jehova chuan Joba a hmangaih em em a, mahse amah hawtu tuemaw a awm a. Tunge a nih i hria em?

Ramhuai Setana a ni. Setana chu Jehova hawtu, vantirhkoh tha lo a ni tih hrereng la. Adama leh Evi chu Jehova thu a awih lohtir thei a, mi dang reng reng pawh Jehova thu awih lohtir theih a inring a. Mahse a thei em? Thei lo. Kan hriat tawh mipa leh hmeichhe rinawm tam takte kha ngaihtuah teh. Eng zah hming nge i sawi theih?

Aigupta-ah Jakoba leh Josefa an thih hnuah, Joba chu lei chung zawng zawngah Jehova laka mi rinawm ber a ni a. Mi tin tha lo a nihtir thei lo tih Setanan hria se Jehovan a duh a, chuvangin: ‘Joba en teh. Ka laka a rinawmzia hi hmu rawh,’ a ti a.

Setana chuan: ‘Amah mal i sawm leh thil tha tam tak a neih vangin a rinawm a ni. Mahse chung chu i lak bo chuan anchhia a lawh mai ang che,’ tiin a hnial a.

Chuvangin Jehova chuan: ‘Ti ta che. La bo rawh. Joba chunga thil tha lo tih i duh zawng zawng chu ti rawh. Anchhia mi lawh leh lawh loh kan hria ang chu. Tih chu tihlum hlek suh ang che,’ a ti a. A hmasain Setanan mite chu Joba ran ruai leh sanghawngseite a ruktir a, tin a beramte chu tihhlum an ni a. Tin a fapa leh fanu 10-te chu thlipuiin a tihlum leh a. A hnuah Setana chuan Joba chu he natna rapthlak tak hi a veitir leh a. Chuvang chuan Joba nupui chuan: ‘Pathian chu anchhia lawh la thi rawh,’ a ti a ni. Mahse Joba chuan a ti dawn lo. Thian der pathum pawh an lo kal a, nun tha lova nung a ni tiin an rawn hrilh a. Mahse Joba chu a rinawm zel a.

Chu chuan Jehova a tihlim em em a, milema i hmuh theih ang hian, a hnuah Joba chu mal a sawm a. A natna a tihdam sak a. Joba chuan fa hmeltha zawk 10 leh ran ruai, beram leh sanghawngseite a hmaa a neih let hniha tam a nei a.

Joba angin Jehova lakah i rinawm reng ang em? I rinawm chuan, Pathianin mal a sawm ve ang che. Leilung pum pui hi Eden huan anga mawia siam a nih hunah chatuanin i nung thei ang.Joba 1:1-22; 2:1-13; 42:10-17. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

data.titulo: Lalber Ṭha Lovin Aigupta A Awp
data.contenido:
HETA mite hian mipui hi hna an thawh luihtir a. Hna thawktu zinga pakhat vuakna hruia vawtu hi en teh! Hnathawktute chu Jakoba chhungkuaa mi an ni a, Israel-mite vuah an ni. Hna thawh luihtirtute chu Aigupta-mite an ni. Israel-mite chu Aigupta-mite bawih an ni ta. Chu chu engtinnge a lo nih?

Kum tam tak chhung chuan Jakoba chhungkaw tam tak chu Aigupta-ah inremin an awm a. Pharaoa dawta Aigupta-a mi pawimawh ber Josefa chuan anmahni a enkawl a. Mahse Josefa chu a thi ta a. Israel-mite duh lotu Pharaoa thar chu Aiguta lalber a ni ta a.

Tichuan chu Pharaoa tha lo chuan Israel-mite chu bawihah a siam a. Mi tawrawt leh sualte chu anmahni enkawltuah a dah a. Pharaoa tan khawpui siamin Israel-mite chu an thawhrim Juihtir nasa em em a. Mahse Israel-mite chu an pung zel tho va. Rei loteah Israel-mite chu an tam Jutukin an chak lutuk ang tih Aigupta-mite chuan an hlau ta a. Pharaoan enge a tih i hria em? Israel nuten nau an hrin a anmahni tanpuitu hmeichhiate hnenah thu a sawi a: ‘Nausen mipa piang tawh phawt chu in tihlum tur a ni,’ a ti a.

Chutichuan Pharaoa chuan he thupek hi a mipui zawng zawng hnenah a pe a: ‘Israel-mite nausen mipate chu la ula, tihlum rawh u. Nausen hmeichhiate chauh zuah rawh u,’ tiin. Chu chu thupek atan a rapthlak a ni lawm ni? Nausen mipate zinga pakhat chhandam a nih dan i en ang u.Exodus 1:6-22. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

data.titulo: Nausên Mosia Chhandam A Nih Dân
data.contenido:
NAUSEN te tak te ṭap, nula kutzungtang chelh hi en teh. Hei hi Mosia a ni. Nula hmel tha tak hi tunge a nih i hria em? Aigupta lai fanu, Pharaoa fanu ngei a ni.

Aigupta-mite tihhlum a nih a duh loh vangin Mosia nu chuan a nausen chu thla thum a nih thlengin a thukru a. Mahse Mosia chu an hmuchhuak leh thei tih a hria a, chuvangin amah chhandam turin heti hian a ti a.

Bawm a la a, tui luh loh nan a tiphui a. Tin a chhungah chuan Mosia a dah a, bawm chu Nile Luipui dunga hnim sang tak karah a dah a. Mosia farnu Miriami chu a kiang hnaia ding a, enge lo thleng tih en tura hrilh a ni a. Rei loteah Nile Luipuiah chuan inbual turin Pharaoa fanu a lo kal a. Hnim sang kara bawm chu a hmu nghal a. A chhiahhlawh nulate zinga pakhat a ko va: ‘Saw bawm saw mi va lak teh,’ a ti a. Lai fanu chuan bawm chu a han hawn chuan nausen hmel tha deuh a hmu a. Nausen Mosia chu a tap a, lai fanu chuan a lainat a. Tihhlum a nih a duh lo va.

Tin Miriami a lo chhuak a. Milemah hian i hmu thei e. ‘Nausen awm sak tur chein Israel-mi hmeichhia ka va ko ang em?’ tiin Miriami chuan Pharaoa fanu chu a zawt a.

‘Khawngaihtakin va ko rawh,’ lai fanu chuan a ti a.

Tichuan Miriami chu a nu hrilh turin rang takin a kal ta a. Lai fanu hnena Mosia nu a lo thlen chuan, lai fanu chuan: ‘He nausen hi la la, mi awm sak rawh, hlawh ka pe ang che,’ a ti a.

Chutiang chuan Mosia nu chuan ama fa chu a enkawl ta a. A hnuah Mosia a upat tawk hnuah, ama fapa anga lo pawmtu Pharaoa fanu hnenah chuan a hruai a. Chu chu Pharaoa ina Mosia lo than len dan chu a ni.Exodus 2:1-10. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

AIGUPTA atanga Mosia tlan bo hi en teh. Amah umtu mite i hmu thei em? Engvanginnge Mosia tihhlum an duh i hria em? Kan hre thei emaw i en ang u.

Mosia chu Aigupta awptu Pharaoa inah a seilian a. Mi fing leh ropui deuh a lo ni a. Mosia chuan Aigupta mi a nih loh va, a nu leh pa chu Israel-mi, bawih an ni tih a hria a.

Kum 40-a upa a lo nihin, ni khat chu Mosia chuan a mite engtinnge an awm tih en tura kal a tum a. An sawisak dan a rapthlak. Aigupta-miin Israel-mi bawih a vaw lai a hmu a. Mosia chu a hawi vel a, tumahin an en a hmuh loh veleh Aigupta-mi chu a vua a, Aigupta-mi chu a thi ta a. Mosia chuan a ruang chu tiauvutah a thukru a.

A tukah chuan Mosia chu a mite en turin a kal leh a. Bawih ni tawh lo tura tanpui theiah a inngai a. Mahse Israel mi pahnih insual lai a hmu ta a. Mosia chuan a dik lo zawk hnenah chuan: ‘Engvanginnge i unaupa i velh?’ a ti a.

Chu pa chuan: ‘Tuinnge kan chunga roreltuah siam che? Kha Aiguptami i tihhlum ang bawk khan mi tihlum ve dawn em ni? a ti ta a.

Mosian a hlau ta a. Aigupta-mi chunga a tih chu mipuiin an hre chhuak tawh tih a hria a. Pharaoa meuh pawhin a hria a, Mosia tihlum turin mite a tir a. Chuvang chuan Mosia chu Aigupta ata a tlanbo ta a ni.

Mosian Aigupta a chhuahsan chuan Midian ram hla takah a kal a. Chutah chuan Jethroa chhungkua a hmu a, a fanute zinga pakhat, Zipori chu nupuiah a nei a. Mosia chu berampu a ni ta a, Jethroa beram a enkawl a. Kum 40 chhung Midian ramah a cheng a. Tunah chuan kum 80 a ni ta. Tichuan ni khat chu, Mosian Jethroa beram a ven laiin Mosia nun pumhlum thlaktirtu thil mak tak a lo awm a. A phek hi keu la, chu thil mak chu enge ni i en ang u.Exodus 2:11-25; Tirhkohte 7:22-29. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

MOSIA chu a beram tana hnim hmu turin Horeb tlang thlengin a lo kal a. Chutah chuan hnimbuk alh a hmu a, mahse a kang si lo va!

‘Hei hi a va mak e. Ka hnaih ang a ka en chiang teh ang,’ Mosia chuan a ti rilru a. A han hnaih chuan, hnimbuk atang chuan aw a lo chhuak a: ‘Rawn hnaih tawh suh. Lei thianghlima ding i nih vangin i pheikhawk phelh rawh,’ tiin. V antirhkoh hmangin Pathian a tawng a ni. Chuvang chuan Mosian a hmai a khuh a.

Pathian chuan: ‘Aigupta-a ka mite na tuar ka hmu tawh a. Chuvangin anmahni ka chhuahtir dawn a, Aigupta ata ka mite hruai chhuak tura ka tirh tur chu nangmah i ni,’ a ti ta a. Jehovan a mite chu Kanaan ram mawi takah a hruai dawn a ni.

Mahse Mosia chuan: ‘Engmah ka ni lo. Engtinnge chu chu ka tih theih ang? Tin kal pawh ni ila. Israel-mite chuan ka hnenah: ‘Tunge tir che?’ an ti ang a. Enge ka sawi ang?’ a ti a.

Pathianin a chhang a: ‘Hei hi i sawi tur chu a ni, “Abrahama Pathian, Isaka Pathian leh Jakoba Pathian Jehova chuan in hnenah mi tir,“ ti ang che,’ a ti a. Tin Jehova chuan ‘Hei hi chatuana ka hming a ni,’ tiin a sawi belh a.

‘Nangmahin mi tir tih ka sawi hunah mi ring ta lo sela,’ tiin Mosian a chhang a.

Pathianin: ‘I kutah enge awm?’ tiin a zawt a.

Mosian: ‘Tiang,’ tiin a chhang a.

‘Leiah paih rawh,’ Pathianin a ti a. Mosian a han paih chuan tiang chu rul a ni ta a. Jehovan thilmak dang Mosia a hmuhtir a. ‘I kawr chhungah i kut zen rawh,’ a ti a. Mosian a zen a, a han phawrh leh chuan vur angin a var a! Kut chu pharna an tih natna tha lo tak a kai ang mai a ni a. A hnuah chuan Jehovan Mosia chu thilmak pathumna tih theihna a pe leh a. A tawpah chuan ‘Heng thilmakte hi i tih hunah ka tir che tih Israel-miten an awih ang,’ a ti a.

Chumi hnuah chuan Mosia a haw a, Jethroa hnenah: ‘Engtinnge an awm tih en turin Aigupta-a ka laichinte hnenah mi kaltir rawh,’ a ti a. Tin Jethroa chuan Mosia hnenah dam takin a ti a, Mosia chuan Aigupta lam chu a pan ta a.Exodus 3:1-22; 4:1-20. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

data.titulo: Mosia leh Aronan Pharaoa An Hmu
data.contenido:
AIGUPTA-a Mosia a kir lehin thilmak chanchin zawng zawng a unaupa Arona a hrilh a. Tin Mosia leh Aronan chuan thilmakte chu Israel-mite an hmuhtir chuan, mipuite chuan an vaiin an hnenah Jehova a awm tih an awih a.

Tin Mosia leh Arona chu Pharaoa hmu turin an kal a. ‘Irael Pathian Jehova chuan, “Thlalerah mi biak theih nan ka mite hi ni thum kaltir rawh,“ a ti,’ tiin an hrilh a. Mahse Pharaoan: ‘Jehova ka ring lo. Tin Israel ka kaltir lo vang,’ tiin a chhang a.

Mipuiin Jehova biak nan an hnathawh atanga hun awl neih an duh vangin Pharaoa a thinur a. Chuvang chuan a thawhrim luih zualtir sauh va. Tha lo taka sawisak an ni chu Israel-mite chuan Mosia an mawhchhiat a, Mosia chu a lungngai ta a. Mahse lungkham lo turin Jehovan a hrilh a. Jehova chuan: ‘Pharaoa chu ka mite ka chhuahtir ang,’ a ti a. Mosia leh Arona chu Pharaoa hmu turin an kal leh a. He mi tum hi chuan thilmak an ti a. Arona chuan a tiang a paih a, rul lian puiah a chang a. Mahse Pharaoa mi fingte pawhin an tiangte an han paih ve a, rulte an lo lang a. Mahse en teh! Arona rul chuan mi fingte rul a ei zo ta a. Pharaoa chuan Israel-mite a kaltir dawn rih chuang lo va.

Tichuan Jehovan Pharaoa thil a zirtir hun a thleng a. A tihdan i hria em? Aigupta chunga hri emaw buaina nasa tak thlentirin a ni.

Hri tam tak hnuah Pharaoan Mosia a ko va, ‘Hri titawp rawh, Israel ka kaltir ang e,’ a ti a. Mahse hri a tawp hnu chuan Pharaoan a rilru a thlak leh a. Mipui a kaltir dawn lo. Mahse a tawpah, hri 10-na hnuah Pharaoan Israel-mite a kaltir ta a.

Hri 10-te chu i hre vek em? A phek keu la, a chanchin i zir ang u.Exodus 4:27-31; 5:1-23; 6:1-13, 26-30; 7:1-13. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

MILEMTE hi en teh. Aigupta chunga Jehova hri thlentir an lantir theuh va. Milem hmasa berah hian, Aronan a tianga Nile Luipui a vaw lai i hmu thei a. A vuak veleh luipuia tui chu thisenah a chang a. Sangha an thi a, luipui chu a uih tan ta a. A dawtah, Nile Luipui atangin Jehovan chungu a chhuahtir a. Hmun tinah an awm-thukah, chhang hmehna thlengah, mi khumah-hmun tinah. Chungute an thih chuan Aiguptamite chuan an dah vum ther thur a, ram chu a uih hluah hluah mai a.

Tin Aronan a tiangin lei a vua a, vaivut chu thosiah a chang ta a. Chung chu mi seh thei te tak te thlawk thei chu an ni. Thosite chu Aigupta ram chunga hri pathumna a ni. Hri dangte chuan Aigupta-mite chauh an tina, Israel-mite tina ve lovin. Palina chu Aigupta zawng zawng ina thlawk lut tho lian pui pui chu a ni. Hri pangana chu ran chungah a ni a. Aigupta-mite ran malte leh beram leh kel tam tak an thi a.

A dawtah, Mosia leh Aronan vut an la a, boruakah an paih a. Mite leh ran chungah panchhia an awmtir a. Chu chu hri parukna a ni.

Chumi hnuah chuan Mosian van lamah a kut a phar a, Jehovan rial leh khawpui ri a tir a. Aigupta-a rial tla nasa ber a la ni. Hri pariatna chu khaukhuap puang tam deuh a ni a. Englai mahin chumi hma chuan emaw a hnuah emaw chuti khawpa khaukhuap tam a la awm ngai lo. Rialin a tihboral loh thil tinreng an ei zo ta a.

Hri pakuana chu thimna a ni a. Ni thum chhung chu thim chhah deuhvin ram a tuam a, mahse Israel-mite chuan an chennaah eng an nei a.

A tawpah Pathianin a mite chu an kawngka bianga kel tuai emaw beram tuai emaw thisen tat turin a hrilh a. Tin Pathian vantirhkohvin Aigupta a rawn kal hlen a. Vantirhkohvin thisen a hmuh chuan chu inah chuan tumah a tihlum lo va. Mahse kawngkabianga thisen awm lohna in zawng zawngah chuan, Pathian vantirhkoh chuan mihring leh ran fa tir a tihlum zel a. Chu chu hri 10-na a ni.

Chu hri hnuhnung ber hnuah chuan Pharaoan kal chhuak turin Israel-mite a hrilh a. Pathian mite chu kal tura inpeih sa an ni a, chumi zan ngei chuan Aigupta atangin an chhuak tan ta a.Exodus bung 7 aṭanga 12. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate

ENGE lo thleng hi en teh. Tuipui Sen chunga tiang lek hi Mosia a ni. Ral lehlama him taka a hnena awmte hi Israel-mite an ni. Mahse Pharaoa leh a sipai rual zawng zawng chu tuipuiah an tla a. Chu chu a lo nih dan i en ang u.

Kan hriat tawh angin Aigupta-mite chungah Pathianin hri 10-na a thlentir hnuah Aigupta chhuahsan turin Pharaoan Israel-mite a hrilh a. Hmeichhia leh naupang tam tak nen Israel-mi mipa 600,000 vel an kal chhuak a. Jehova ringtu rawn ni ve ta mi dang tam tak pawh Israel-mite rualin an chhuak bawk a. An beram leh kelte leh ran rual an hruai theuh bawk a.

An chhuah hmain Israel-miten Aigupta-mite hnenah silhfen leh tangkarua leh rangkachaka siam thilte an ngen a. Aigupta mite chuan an chunga hri hnuhnung ber avang chuan an hlau em em a. Chuvangin an ngen thil tinreng Israel-mite chu an pe a.

Ni tlem te hnuah Israel-mite chuan Tuipui Sen an thleng a. Chutah chuan an chawl a. Chutih chhung chuan Pharaoa leh a mite chuan Israel-mite an kal botir chu pawi an ti tan ta a. ‘Kan bawihte kan kaltir ta si,’ an ti a.

Tichuan Pharaoan a rilru a thlak leh pek a. Rang takin a raldona tawlailir leh sipai ruai a inpeihtir a. Tichuan indona tawlailir bik 600 leh Aigupta tawlailir dang nen Israel-mite an um ta a.

Israel-miten an hnunga Pharaoa leh a sipai rual lo kal an hmuhin, an hlau em em a. Tlan bona kawng a awm si lo va. An sir lehlamah chuan Tuipui Sen a awm a, hei lehlam atangin Aigupta-mite an lo kal si. Mahse Jehovan a mite leh Aigupta mite inkarah chhum a dah a. Chuvangin Aigupta-mite chuan beih turin Israel-mite chu an hmu thei lo va.

Tuipui Sen chunga a tiang lek turin Jehovan Mosia a hrilh a. A lek veleh, Jehovan khawchhak thli na deuh a tlehtir a. Tuipuia tuite chu a inthen a, tuite chu lehlam lehlama chelh din an ni a.

Tichuan Israel-mite chu lei hulah tuipui chu an kal kai tan ta a. Ran zawng zawng nen mi maktaduai tam tak him taka ral lehlam an kal kai nan darkar tam tak a ngai a. A tawpah, Aigupta-mite chuan Israel-mite chu an hmu thei leh ta a. An bawihte an kal bo mek ta! Chuvangin anmahni umin tuipuiah an tlan lut a.

An tlan luh veleh an tawlailir kete Pathianin a tithlawn a. Aigupta-mite chuan an hlau ta em em a: ‘Israel-mite lamah Jehova a tang a ni. Heta ta hi i chhuak ang u!’ tiin an au ta a. Mahse a tlai lutuk ta.

Chu chu Tuipui Sen chunga a tlang lek tura Jehovan Mosia a hrilh lai chu a ni, milema i hmuh ang hian. Mosian a lek veleh, tui bangte chu an chim a. Sipai ruai zawng zawngin tuipuiah Israel-mite an zui lut tawh a. Aigupta mi pakhat mah damin an chhuak lo. Pathian mipuite zawng zawng chhandam an ni chu an va hlim em! Mipate chuan: ‘Jehovan hnehna ropui a hneh ta. Sakawrte leh an chungchuangte tuipuiah a paih lut ta,’ tiin, Jehova hnenah fakna hla an sa a. Mosia farnu Miriami chuan a darbenthek a la a, hmeichhia zawng zawngin an darbenthek nen an zui a. Lawma an lam pahin, mipaten chu hla bawk chu an sa a. ‘Jehovan hnehna ropui a hneh ta. Sakawrte leh an chungchuangte tuipuiah a paih lut ta,’ tih hi an sa a.Exodus bung 12 aṭanga 15. Zirna Atâna Zawhnate
